reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch treat the Deuteronomic exclusion of eunuchs as a covenant-infancy ordinance that lost its force once the kingdom of God spread beyond Israel.

sides.snippet: He who is wounded in the stones, or has his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the assembly of Yahweh.
sides.verseText: He who is wounded in the stones, or has his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the assembly of Yahweh.

sides.snippet: there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake
sides.verseText: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.\"
